contents.content: There are 10-15 questions. There is no time limit.

_data.content:
This test will check what you have learned in this lesson.
  • Talk about hypothetical situations about the past.
  • Shift emphasis by using what, who, or that.
  • Quote other people.
  • Ask for clarification and confirmation.
  • Talk about reactions and behavior.
